subject: Literature
title: Galileo's Dialogue and Scientific Censorship
description: A fast breakdown of Galileo's Dialogue and Scientific Censorship for builders.

hook.text: Galileo proved the Earth orbits the Sun, and the Church forced him to deny his own findings under threat of torture.

buildup.text: His Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems used fictional characters to argue for the Copernican model.

discovery.text: He named the character defending the Church's position Simplicio, an insult the Pope took very personally.

twist.text: After his forced recantation, Galileo allegedly whispered 'And yet it moves,' defying the Church in silence.

climax.text: The Vatican did not formally admit Galileo was right until 1992, three hundred and fifty years after his death.

punchline.text: Truth waited 350 years for an official apology.

quiz.question: When did the Vatican formally admit Galileo was correct?
options: Immediately after his death in the 1600s
In 1992, over three hundred and fifty years later
They have never acknowledged his findings
